title: CINCLANT Code Zebra alert over object off Newfoundland
summary: Steven Greer tells of CINCLANT Code Zebra alert over object off Newfoundland, about 1980s at The Atlantic Ocean, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Atlantic Command, Norfolk, Virginia; off Newfoundland

tellings.quote: he was uh working under Sync Atlantic Command, the commander-in-chief Atlantic Command in Norfolk and they went to a full code zebra alert,

plain: Steven Greer, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast who also collects accounts for a book called Disclosure: An Illustrated History, passes on what a man named Merle Shane McDow told him. McDow says that in the 1980s he worked at the US military's Atlantic Command in Norfolk, Virginia, the headquarters run by the commander-in-chief for the Atlantic, under Admiral Harry Train, and that they went to a full "Code Zebra" alert, a top-level alarm, over an unknown object off the coast of Newfoundland in Canada. If true, it would mean a major military command treated a UFO as a serious threat.
